title: 第九章 规则的规则
slug: 电锯人开局契约斩杀线恶魔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

感受到对方的回应，言良没有立刻询问制定规则的事，而是抛出了一个刚刚在车上就盘旋在心头的试探：

“刚才在车上，面对那个叫玛奇玛的女人时，如果我真的跟她翻脸，她会按照你的规则被斩杀吗？”

玛奇玛是支配恶魔，深不可测。如果想利用斩杀线恶魔在这个世界立足，甚至去对抗那些顶级的存在，他必须先搞清楚这只恶魔的态度与能力上限。

“我不在乎。”

斩杀线恶魔的声音毫无感情，透着一种超然的冷漠：

“在我的规则面前，一切都是平等的。这世上的任何存在，对我来说都没有区别。”

“至于支配恶魔，如果她挡了你的路，你想杀就杀，想留就留。作为我的契约者，我给予你处置一切的自由。”

“当然，前提是你划出的线真能框得住她。”

言良眉头微挑，他越发察觉到这只恶魔根本没有人类的喜怒哀乐。

“你为什么会选择和我契约？”言良接着问道。

“你弄错了一点，我没有选择你，只是你恰好做了对的事。”它的声音十分平静，“所谓人类，总是会愚蠢地相信运气的庇佑，这简直是对我最恶毒的嘲讽。但在那时，当所有人都跪下祈求运气庇护的时候，你是唯一一个抬头看到了规则，看到了我的人。”

“我只讲规则，而规则就是逻辑。你能在赌局之中认知到我的存在，并赐予我斩杀线这个完美的名字，就已经证明了你的资格。我与你契约只是逻辑闭环的一部分。”

斩杀线恶魔微微停顿，话锋一转，那空灵的声音变得更加冷漠：

“你知道我最讨厌什么吗？不是弱者。”

“弱者是没有罪过的。他们只是规则筛选的对象，同样是规则的一部分。没有弱者，我的规则就没有存在的意义。而强者的存在也不是为了彰显特权，是为了证明我划下的线是公平的，是可以通过努力跨越的。”

“我真正讨厌的，是无序。”

“就像梦野那种疯子，他的行为就是无序的。他屈从了本能，毫无缘由的向着这个世界宣泄着自己的情绪，这是我所鄙夷的行为。”

“所以，作为你与我契约所付出的代价，也为了不让这种人大行其道，你要去划线……”

“划得越多越好，定下的规则越严苛越好。直到你划下的线笼罩了这整个世界，等到所有人都自发的遵守它们的时候，这世界便是完美的了。”

Page (1/3)

Sensing the other party's response, Yan Liang did not immediately ask about the establishment of rules, but instead threw out a temptation that had been lingering in his mind just now in the car:

"Just now in the car, when I faced the woman named Makima, if I really fell out with her, would she be killed according to your rules?"

Machima is the dominating demon, unfathomable.If he wants to use the killing line demon to gain a foothold in this world, or even fight against those top-level beings, he must first understand the attitude and upper limit of this demon's abilities.

"I don't care."

The voice of the killing line demon was emotionless, revealing a kind of detached indifference:

"Everything is equal before my rules. There is no difference between any existence in this world to me."

"As for controlling the demon, if she blocks your way, you can kill her if you want, and keep her if you want. As my contractor, I give you the freedom to deal with everything."

"Of course, the premise is that the line you draw can really frame her."

Yan Liang raised his eyebrows slightly, and he realized more and more that this demon had no human emotions at all.

"Why did you choose to make a contract with me?" Yan Liang then asked.

"You made a mistake. I didn't choose you, but you happened to do the right thing." Its voice was very calm. "The so-called human beings will always foolishly believe in the blessing of luck. This is simply the most vicious mockery of me. But at that time, when everyone knelt down to pray for the protection of luck, you were the only one who looked up and saw the rules and me."

"I only talk about rules, and rules are logic. The fact that you can recognize my existence in the gambling game and give me the perfect name of Killing Line has already proved your qualifications. My contract with you is just part of the closed loop of logic."

The killing line demon paused slightly, then changed the topic, and the ethereal voice became more cold:

"You know what I hate most? Not weaklings."

"The weak are not guilty. They are just the targets of the rules and are also part of the rules. Without the weak, my rules have no meaning. The existence of the strong is not to show privileges, but to prove that the line I draw is fair and can be crossed through hard work."

"What I really hate is Discord."

"Just like a lunatic like Meng Ye, his behavior is disordered. He succumbed to his instincts and vented his emotions to the world for no reason. This is behavior that I despise."

"So, as the price you pay for the contract with me, and in order to prevent such people from becoming popular, you have to draw a line..."

"The more you draw, the better, and the stricter the rules you set, the better. Until the lines you draw cover the entire world, and when everyone spontaneously abides by them, the world will be perfect."
